subject.en: A brass and navy pocket compass
subject.zh: 黄铜与深蓝的袖珍罗盘

description.en: A red-and-ivory needle crosses a deep navy compass face. The close brass hanging ring and complete circular instrument share one gentle diagonal.
description.zh: 红白指针划过深蓝罗盘，紧靠的黄铜提环与完整仪器沿同一条温和斜线组织。

description.en: Softly brushed brass, a controlled glass reflection and engraved direction marks retain physical depth. The hanging-ring opening is truly transparent.
description.zh: 柔和拉丝黄铜、克制玻璃反光和方向刻痕保留拟物深度，提环镂空保持真实透明。

description.en: Latitude arcs, a sparse meridian fan and short bearing marks in pale harbor-blue paper. The field, grain and contact shadow are independent of transparent app marks.
description.zh: 浅蓝纸面上的经纬弧线与偏移导航刻度，呼应 IP 位置查询。 底色、颗粒与接触阴影均独立于透明应用标记。

sizeNote.en: At 128/64 px, the gold compass rim and red needle remain clear. At 32/24/16 px, the compact silhouette and dominant colors carry recognition; fine material detail, printed marks and background lines naturally merge.
sizeNote.zh: 128/64 px 能辨认金色罗盘外缘与红色指针；32/24/16 px 以紧凑轮廓和主色维持识别，精细材质、印记与背景线条自然合并。

goal.en: Give network diagnostic tools IP location and network data, plus observations of DNS resolver exit addresses.
goal.zh: 为网络诊断工具提供 IP 位置与运营商信息，并观察 DNS 解析器的出口地址。

role.zh: IP API 与结果收集服务
本地 API 运行时与工作区管理
IP 查询 HTTP 路由
短期保存解析器观察记录

role.en: IP service unit and HTTP tests
role.zh: IP 服务单元与 HTTP 测试

description.en: Latitude arcs, a sparse meridian fan and short bearing marks extend the compass’s sense of direction.
description.zh: 纬线弧、稀疏经线与短方位刻度，将罗盘的方向感延伸到画面之外。

alt.zh: 黄铜与深蓝的袖珍罗盘，置于 Hexly 宣发画布

caption.zh: 清楚知道，此刻从哪里连接。

description.zh: 黄铜与深蓝的袖珍罗盘。

description.en: Preserve the exact project identity and the separately recorded Hexly artwork. Hexly paper, ink and terracotta belong to archive and campaign surfaces only; independent product palettes and themes stay their own.
description.zh: 项目原标与单独记录的 Hexly 主视觉均保持形状和原色。Hexly 纸色、墨色和陶土色只用于档案及宣发画布，各产品色板与主题独立保留。

description.en: Preserve the complete subject and its original square margins. Resize uniformly; never trim the canvas to force detail. Keep external clear space of at least 1/8 of the mark canvas height around standalone marks and lockups. Wide and mobile Heroes are separate compositions of existing artwork, with no image-model call.
description.zh: 保留完整主体与原有方形留白，只做等比缩放，不裁图强凑细节。独立标志及字标组合四周，至少留出标志画布高度 1/8 的外部净空。宽幅与手机 Hero 分别排版，没有新图像模型调用。

description.en: Navigation 24px preferred, 16px minimum. Wordmark ≥60px wide; lockup ≥160px. Use transparent PNG/ICO at small sizes without a tile, extra red dot, shadow or rounded mask. Fine facets soften at 16px.
description.zh: 导航推荐 24px，最小 16px。字标宽度至少 60px，组合至少 160px。小尺寸使用透明 PNG/ICO，不加底板、红点、阴影或圆角遮罩；16px 时细小切面会柔化。
